title: Founded Bluestar in 1984 as a small industrial-solvents factory and
statement: Founded Bluestar in 1984 as a small industrial-solvents factory and grew it into China National Bluestar Group.

title: From 1996
statement: From 1996, consolidated more than 100 troubled, government-owned chemical factories into what became ChemChina, later pursuing the acquisition of Syngenta.
outcome: ChemChina grew into the Fortune Global 500's 265th-largest company and completed the roughly $43 billion Syngenta acquisition, with Ren also becoming chairman of Pirelli.
